title: Explicit affine base-change ring diagram on the order tail
statement: Let I be a preorder, R:I → CommRing a functor, i∈I, Y a scheme [def-pc-scheme], s:Y → Spec R(i), and t:Spec Γ(Y) ≅ Y. Define the indexing functor τ:Set.Ici i → Under i by τ(j)=(i→j). Put a=Spec.preimage(t.hom ≫ s):R(i)→Γ(Y). The diagram F=τ ⋙ Under.post R ⋙ Under.pushout a ⋙ Under.forget B is the specialization of the existing categorical pushout-system construction: F(j)=pushout(R(i)→R(j),a), with transition maps induced by pushout.desc. Its initial ring map r:Γ(Y)→F(i) is pushout.inr at the identity arrow of i. Thus F and r are actual categorical constructions, not witnesses selected from an unproved existence statement.
